## 2026-11-08 08:28 · claude-macbook · immersive-interface-pack

Animated items looked darker in GUI. The owner traced it to Shadow Drop 3.0.4, whose shadows draw over animated items. Mechanism: ImmediatelyFast batch_animated_item_updates sends animated items to its own AnimatedItemAtlas texture, while Shadow Drop (inject before GuiRenderState.forEachItem in prepareItemElements) blits shadows from the vanilla itemAtlas. Different textures likely get re-batched, putting the shadow above the item. Set immediatelyfast.json batch_animated_item_updates=false (backup immediatelyfast.json.bak); needs a restart; owner to verify.

## 2026-11-08 07:56 · claude-macbook · immersive-interface-pack

Fresh Textures v2.0.1.1 (26.3 overlay) overrides only core/clouds.vsh (outputs loc 0-1). The Atmospherics 2.6.8 mod overrides the clouds.vsh+fsh pair, and its fsh reads loc 0-12. Resource packs outrank mod assets, so the pair is mismatched: the 8 cloud pipelines fail, the reload fails, and MC clears all selected packs. Fix: removed 26.3/.../clouds.vsh from the Fresh zip (original in pack-backups/Fresh Textures v2.0.1.1.orig.zip). Pack list was recovered from the 07:52:03 'Reloading ResourceManager' log line. A background watcher rewrites options.txt (resourcePacks + 9 incompatibleResourcePacks) when game pid 52715 exits; the old file is kept as options.txt.pre-restore.

## 2026-11-08 07:13 · claude-macbook · immersive-interface-pack

Owner confirmed the quadalign mod fixed the II GUIs. uku's Armor HUD style HOTBAR (and ROUNDED_CORNERS) draws partial slices of hud/hotbar. II's hotbar.png is 364x44 with markers only at its 4 corners, and the shader expands the quad assuming the full 182x22 hotbar, so slices warp. Style ROUNDED uses only hud/hotbar_offhand_left slices (II retextures that sprite without markers), so it renders cleanly. Advised: Mod Menu > uku's Armor HUD > Style = Rounded.
